If your Headset can't connect to your PC after the most recent update:

You just need to make sure your headset can reach the VD and Meta servers at least once after installing the 1.34.25 update on your headset.

This is not avoidable.

You will not need to be connected long enough for your headset OS to update.

If your headset is rooted try the steps here: https://discord.com/channels/564087419918483486/588170196968013845/1567380624489185361
